name: Tenjin Akiko
source:
The chairman of the Love Support Committee. She is a second year high school student and a beautiful girl in the first class. Contrary to her appearance, her personality is difficult and she always has absolute confidence that she is right. Her grades have always been top class, and when she was in middle school she was admired and respected.

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
